name: 5,6-MDO-DiPT
summary: 5,6-MDO-DiPT, also known as 5,6-methylenedioxy-N,N-diisopropyltryptamine, is a lesser-known chemical compound of the tryptamine family. It is the 5,6-methylenedioxy derivative of diisopropyltryptamine (DiPT) and is an analogue of 5-MeO-DiPT. The drug is included as an entry in Alexander Shulgin's 1991 book TiHKAL (Tryptamines I Have Known and Loved).

uses.en: It is a little-known research compound described in Shulgin's work.
uses.zh: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一種鮮為人知的研究用化合物。
uses.zhHans: 它是Shulgin著作中描述的一种鲜为人知的研究用化合物。

fact.en: Alexander Shulgin listed it in TiHKAL. The methylenedioxy bridge it carries, a carbon joining two oxygens into a ring, is the same feature that gives MDMA its name.
fact.zh: Alexander Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出了它。它所帶的亞甲二氧基橋，也就是一個碳連接兩個氧形成的環，正是MDMA名稱中那個結構特徵。
fact.zhHans: Alexander Shulgin在《TiHKAL》中列出了它。它所带的亚甲二氧基桥，也就是一个碳连接两个氧形成的环，正是MDMA名称中那个结构特征。
